description: This is a migration script for Entity Framework Core, modifying the schema of the database by changing the 'BuyerId' columns in 'Orders' and 'Baskets' tables.

classes.name: FixBuyerId
classes.description: A migration class inheriting from Migration, defines schema changes to alter the 'BuyerId' columns.

methods.name: Up
methods.description: Defines the operations to migrate the database schema to the new version, changing 'BuyerId' columns to nvarchar(256).

methods.name: Down
methods.description: Reverses the schema changes made in Up, restoring the previous 'BuyerId' column definitions.
